title: nirs4all Runtime RtResult v1
$comment: LOCK-RT / RT-002 unified result envelope. A thin wrapper that BINDS the dag-ml native triple (score_set + predictions + manifest + selection_decision) which already co-emit from native_results.write_native_results. `reports` is VERBATIM score_set.reports[] (the partition/level/fold_id/variant_id/target join key). Studio ChainSummary (pivot) and Web RunResult (nest) are deterministic VIEWS of this envelope. Net-new wrapper; adds zero new dag-ml fields and references the dag-ml contracts by $id.

schema_version.$comment: The RtResult envelope's own version (net-new), independent of the dag-ml ScoreSet/manifest schema versions.

selection.$comment: <- dag-ml selection_decision (winner + ranked) when present; V1 carries the thin {selected_variant} projection from the native manifest, or null.

reports.$comment: VERBATIM score_set.reports[] — each item is a dag-ml regression_metric_report (referenced, not forked).

predictions.$comment: Per-block drill-down rows projected from predictions.parquet / the in-memory Predictions (the arrays a view joins by sample_indices). Not the metric source of truth — reports[] is.

fingerprints.$comment: score_set_hash + plan_id + bundle_id (the native manifest fingerprints available without the coordinator_data_plan_envelope).

portable_level.$comment: CAP-002 classifier slot — opaque referenced field, null in V1.

artifacts.$comment: <- native manifest artifacts[] (dag-ml ArtifactRef list); absent for an in-memory-only result.

diagnostics.$comment: list[RtError] — e.g. 'ran legacy because <cause>' from the run() fallback.
